settings.text: Made for oily roots, workout days and the stretch between washes. It absorbs oil, lifts the crown and brushes out clean on light and dark hair, with a fresh scent that fades by lunchtime.

settings.label: Who it is for
settings.text: Every hair type from fine and straight to thick and coily. Textured hair benefits most when it is sprayed on the scalp rather than the lengths.

settings.label: How to use
settings.text: Shake for ten seconds. Hold the can about eight inches from your roots, spray in sections, wait one minute, then massage with fingertips and brush through.

settings.label: Key ingredients
settings.text: Rice starch for oil absorption, a nutrient-rich berry extract for shine, and a light conditioning agent so hair never feels chalky. Full ingredient list on the pack.

settings.label: Safety
settings.text: Contents under pressure. Keep away from flames and heat, avoid eyes, and do not puncture the can. Use in a ventilated space.

settings.text: Rich in omegas, it lends shine and a soft touch without weight.

settings.text: Adds a dry, airy texture that helps the crown lift.

settings.title: Light conditioning agent
settings.text: Keeps hair smooth and brush-friendly after application.

settings.title: Shake it up
settings.text: Ten good shakes mix the powder with the propellant so the spray comes out evenly.

settings.label: Step two
settings.title: Spray the roots
settings.text: Part hair into sections and spray eight inches away, focusing on the crown and temples.

settings.label: Step three
settings.title: Wait, then work it in
settings.text: Give it a minute to absorb, rub in with fingertips, then brush or style as normal.

settings.label: Will it leave a white cast on dark hair?
settings.text: No. The powder is fine and clear-drying; massage it in and any trace disappears.

settings.label: Can I use it on coloured hair?
settings.text: Yes. It is colour-safe and keratin-safe, and it will not strip pigment.

settings.label: How often can I use it?
settings.text: Two or three days in a row, then wash. Buildup is easier to clear with a clarifying shampoo.

settings.label: What is the difference between sizes?
settings.text: Same formula in all sizes. Mini is for travel, standard for daily use, large and jumbo save money per ounce.
